Please enjoy the full experience.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the proud imagined voice without another workplace metaphor."},{"field_path":"cards.0.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"Every hello does not need to begin the ordinary way, Kevin. You can arrive at an angle, inspect the situation, and invent your own greeting. When you finally look for your person, that is not surrendering your strangeness; it is sharing it. Give them the second act. Let them notice, answer, and join you without trying to turn your entrance into a standard one.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Varies the repeated direct-address opening while retaining the strong two-act image and the independence-to-connection movement."},{"field_path":"cards.0.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin may not enter a relationship—or even a room—by the obvious route. He can make a sideways arrival, offer an unexpected pose, then check: did you see that? His independence is not the opposite of affection; it is his way into affection. Let him have the odd little entrance, then answer it warmly. A smile, verbal welcome, or brief invitation alongside you tells him originality did not cost him connection.","reason_codes":["overexplained_body","remove_true_overexplanation"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the excellent behavioral insight and practical response while removing explanatory repetition."},{"field_path":"cards.11.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's quiet corner is not vacant; it is where he listens until the vacuum stops making suspicious promises.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the vacuum-specific humor while leaving behind reception-desk language."},{"field_path":"cards.11.card.imperative_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“Please let me hear the whole house before I decide where I belong.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Makes the quote speakable and specific to Kevin's listening-post behavior."},{"field_path":"cards.11.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"Your corner can be a listening post, Kevin. Take the time to sort footsteps, voices, and door sounds. You do not have to stand in the middle of every event to know what is happening. When you are ready, come out. No one needs to drag you into the story; the story can wait for your answer.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Offers a distinct opening while preserving privacy, observation, and voluntary re-entry."},{"field_path":"cards.11.card.no_astro.body.hybrid","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin settles near the edge of the room while his person moves through the house. His ears keep the conversation going. The human learns not to call this absence and instead gives him a calm update: “Kitchen, then walk.” Kevin remains where he is for a moment, processing the bulletin. Later he joins the household as if he had chaired the meeting from the beginning.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","keep_voice_or_rhythm"],"editorial_rationale":"The scene is fluent, complete, and unusually effective at showing the reciprocal listening ritual."},{"field_path":"cards.12.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin can look as though he has volunteered for every job in the house. He greets, watches, joins the game, and keeps track of his people. Then, when the social temperature rises or the action becomes too directed, he may step away. Build an off-duty button into the day: a mat, a quiet interval, and a clear cue that nobody needs anything from him. When rest is part of the assignment, his public enthusiasm becomes easier to trust and easier to enjoy.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","keep_behavioral_grounding"],"editorial_rationale":"The validator advisory is not substantively borne out; the prose is natural, practical, and sharply specific."},{"field_path":"cards.14.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin can consider a sit very seriously, especially if the floor has not yet made a convincing emotional case.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the comfort-versus-rule tension without committee language."},{"field_path":"cards.14.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I understand the rule. My feelings about the floor remain complicated.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the comic mismatch between compliance and bodily comfort in a more dog-specific voice."},{"field_path":"cards.19.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin remembers trust the way a nose remembers a trail: thoroughly, emotionally, and with no shortcut home.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Moves the joke from archive administration to scent, memory, and lasting relational meaning."},{"field_path":"cards.19.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I remember the last version of this relationship. Please be recognizable.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains Kevin's serious trust voice without bureaucratic framing."},{"field_path":"cards.19.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"For Kevin, Trust Reaches Everywhere","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Turns the administrative metaphor into a memorable statement of the whole-life trust theme."},{"field_path":"cards.2.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin meets a new object with one question: should I sniff it carefully, or make it move immediately?","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the investigation-versus-action premise in physical dog behavior."},{"field_path":"cards.20.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin believes every new path is a group activity, even when the group has not yet agreed to leave the sidewalk.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the pack-led expedition joke without policy language."},{"field_path":"cards.20.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin can meet a new path with the confidence of a dog already appointed trail guide. His nose works and his body brightens, but adventure is not an escape from his people; it is a way to bring them into a larger world. Notice the turn-back glance or check-in. Give him room to investigate while keeping a clear social thread: a familiar cue, shared direction, and praise when he reconnects. Exploration grows steadier when belonging travels with it.","reason_codes":["overexplained_body","remove_true_overexplanation"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the key outward-and-back pattern while improving pace and avoiding duplicate explanation."},{"field_path":"cards.21.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I did the sit beautifully. The brushing may now begin with admiration.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains Kevin's performative routine-care humor without departmental language."},{"field_path":"cards.24.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's Unusual Hello Can Become Clear","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Names the claim's practical promise rather than issuing an instruction."},{"field_path":"cards.29.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin brings a toy, then another toy, just in case the first one failed to convey the importance of Kevin.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the comic attention bid in a concrete toy scene."},{"field_path":"cards.29.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Makes Connection a Performance","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Gives the attention-seeking companion style more warmth and editorial character."},{"field_path":"cards.3.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"Bring the whole bright burst, Kevin. You do not have to make yourself smaller to work with your person. Learn the pause, the cue, and the release as parts of the game. When you answer them, your person can trust your power—and you can trust that the fun has not vanished.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains the central training insight while varying the repeated opening architecture."},{"field_path":"cards.32.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I have listened to everyone. A snack and a softer voice should settle this.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Replaces meeting language with Kevin's harmony-seeking, food-aware comic voice."},{"field_path":"cards.33.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"A careful sniff can be the beginning of affection, Kevin. You do not have to rush into liking something because it is presented to you. Take a thoughtful pause and a few steps of your own choosing. Your curiosity is not delaying affection; it is helping affection land somewhere true.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the gentle bond-and-investigation insight with a more distinctive entrance."},{"field_path":"cards.34.card.no_astro.body.hybrid","action":"keep","replacement":"The house goes quiet in that particular way. Kevin arrives with a toy, not as a therapist and not as a clown, but as Kevin: sensitive to the atmosphere and ready to make contact. His human gives him two minutes of tug, then a drink and a rest. The feeling has somewhere to go without becoming everybody's project.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","keep_voice_or_rhythm"],"editorial_rationale":"The existing prose is fluent and unusually well calibrated: it avoids overclaiming while giving the interaction a usable shape."},{"field_path":"cards.36.card.imperative_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“Let me sniff the suspicious shrub until it becomes ordinary.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the shrub-specific novelty premise while removing procedural language."},{"field_path":"cards.36.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Treats Novelty Like Breaking News","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains the case-number wit but makes the headline a recognizable behavioral insight."},{"field_path":"cards.37.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's first impression is usually excellent, unless a surprise appears and his body starts improvising.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains the first-impression-versus-surprise friction without office-audit imagery."},{"field_path":"cards.38.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"Look back, Kevin. Take the offered touch. Then go see what that strange sound was from a safe distance. You do not have to choose between being your own investigator and being close to your person. A good bond does not close the case for you; it gives you somewhere steady to return to.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Varies the opening while preserving the supported tension between independent investigation and relational check-in."},{"field_path":"cards.39.card.full_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's Neptune in Sagittarius occupies Doghouse 10, the visible pack-function part of his chart. Neptune describes porous attention, imagination, and sensitivity to atmosphere; Sagittarius carries that sensitivity outward toward roaming, horizon-minded experience. In public or group settings, Kevin may absorb the mood of an outing and help make it feel more spacious or adventurous. Pair room for scent, weather, and wonder with a clear navigation cue, so his atmospheric attentiveness remains connected to the group.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Separates Neptune's permeable absorption, Sagittarius's outward roaming style, and Doghouse 10's visible group role."},{"field_path":"cards.39.card.full_astro.body.hybrid","action":"replace","replacement":"With Neptune in Sagittarius in Doghouse 10, Kevin's public role is not simply to wander: he absorbs an outing's atmosphere and turns it toward shared adventure. His human makes room for a pause at scent or sky, then offers a clear cue onward. Kevin contributes the feeling of the wider world; the human keeps the route legible. Together, an errand becomes an outing without becoming a drift apart.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Restores the interaction among atmosphere, adventure, and visible shared function."},{"field_path":"cards.39.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin may take in a place with his whole presence. A breeze, shifting smell, or open path can draw him into soft, absorbed attention—and that attention can make the rest of the group slow down too. His gift is both sensory and social: he notices the mood of an outing, then makes it feel worth sharing. Let walks include unhurried sensory time, alongside a clear cue that gathers everyone back to the route.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Makes Kevin's place-absorption and group-facing contribution distinct rather than treating them as one broad trait."},{"field_path":"cards.39.card.no_astro.body.hybrid","action":"replace","replacement":"The human thinks they are taking Kevin for a routine walk. Kevin finds a patch of wind, lifts his head, and turns the sidewalk briefly ceremonial. His person waits for the sniff, looks up too, then gives the cue to continue. Kevin has not merely delayed the errand; he has shared a feeling of the place, and the human has kept that feeling connected to the journey.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the memorable ceremonial sidewalk image while clarifying the shared-function mechanism."},{"field_path":"cards.4.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's toy basket is not storage; it is a pile of very persuasive reasons to come play with him.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the toy-as-relationship-bid insight without proposal-archive framing."},{"field_path":"cards.4.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I brought the toy, the enthusiasm, and a very good reason to look at me.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the speakable, performative dog voice while avoiding agenda language."},{"field_path":"cards.4.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"When Kevin Brings a Toy, He Brings Connection","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Converts a clever label into a warm claim-specific insight."},{"field_path":"cards.40.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin does not hold grudges; he remembers the mood, the timing, and where everyone was standing.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the lasting-memory premise without committee framing."},{"field_path":"cards.40.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin does not hand out deep trust casually. Once he has chosen you, he may study your voice, follow a change in the room, or stay close when something feels different. The heart of that focus is relational: he wants the bond to feel steady and reciprocal. Keep important routines calm, give him a predictable place to settle, and invite rather than force contact. When he checks in, answer quietly and clearly. His intensity is the way he protects what love means to him.","reason_codes":["overexplained_body","remove_true_overexplanation"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains the essential trust insight and practical guidance while tightening repetition."},{"field_path":"cards.40.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Watches the Bonds That Matter","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Gives the trust-intensity claim more image and specificity than a generic statement of seriousness."},{"field_path":"cards.42.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Comes Alive When He Can Help","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Replaces an instructional label with a warm, claim-specific insight about participation."},{"field_path":"cards.44.card.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"“I practiced the safe thing. I assume this earns a snack and a proud look.”","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the training-and-security premise in Kevin's imagined voice."},{"field_path":"cards.44.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Grows Through the Routines That Hold language."},{"field_path":"cards.48.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin believes every outing improves when a golden retriever announces it with enough language."},{"field_path":"cards.48.card.no_astro.headline.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin Makes Every Departure an Occasion","reason_codes":["generic_or_administrative_headline","restore_specificity"],"editorial_rationale":"Captures his public, adventure-facing pack role in a memorable behavioral line."},{"field_path":"cards.49.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's favorite game has room for one trusted person, one clear trick, and as many encore snacks as dignity permits.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the secure-play-and-reward premise without venue or policy framing."},{"field_path":"cards.49.card.full_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's Part of Fortune in Cancer in Doghouse 5 describes an easy reward channel through play, tricks, comfort resources, and secure pack connection. The Part of Fortune points to what eases effort and brings reward; Cancer makes emotional safety central; Doghouse 5 places that ease in joyful play and performance. A familiar person, clear game, and modest reward can therefore make willing effort come easily. Keep sessions brief, repeat successful patterns, and finish while the exchange still feels warm. Here, play organizes both pleasure and security.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Distinguishes the easy channel, Cancerian security, and Doghouse 5 play rather than flattening them into general reward sensitivity."},{"field_path":"cards.49.card.full_astro.body.hybrid","action":"replace","replacement":"The Part of Fortune in Cancer in Doghouse 5 makes Kevin's easy reward channel a blend of safety, play, and small success. His person chooses a familiar game, gives a clear chance to win, and responds warmly; Kevin offers the trick again because the exchange feels secure before the reward arrives. Cancer supplies belonging, Doghouse 5 supplies play, and the easy channel lets delight travel between them.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps all three semantic contributions active in the shared scene."},{"field_path":"cards.49.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin often learns and plays most freely when three things arrive together: a familiar person, a clear little game, and a reward he can understand. The treat or praise matters, but so does the secure exchange around it. Watch for the moment his body brightens and his attention becomes willing. Repeat that pattern without overloading it. For Kevin, a small success shared with someone trusted may be richer than a more exciting but confusing prize.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Clarifies the interaction among familiarity, play success, reward, and security."},{"field_path":"cards.49.card.no_astro.body.hybrid","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin offers a trick; his person answers with a clear reward and warm recognition. The game stays short, familiar, and easy to understand. Soon he is not performing under pressure but playing inside a secure exchange, where success itself feels good before the snack arrives. The theater is small, the audience is trusted, and Kevin is delighted to offer another ticket.","reason_codes":["compound_semantic_flattening","preserve_compound_semantics"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves the lively theater image while showing how safety, play, and reward work together."},{"field_path":"cards.5.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin may register a room's emotional tone before the people in it have named theirs. A hurried household, tense voice, or changed rhythm can show up in his posture, pace, or wish to stay close. He benefits from comfort that is tangible and repeatable: a quiet corner, familiar bed, calm voice, slow greeting, and predictable settling sequence. This is not a demand to organize the world around him. It is a reliable way back to calm.","reason_codes":["overexplained_body","remove_true_overexplanation"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the vivid body-based sensitivity and useful settling guidance with a cleaner close."},{"field_path":"cards.6.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin likes to inspect home before leaving, as if the couch might have important travel advice.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Turns the departure routine into a concrete den-to-adventure joke."},{"field_path":"cards.7.card.no_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"replace","replacement":"Your unusual pause, careful approach, or quiet decision can carry a great deal, Kevin. You do not need a grand display to show that you understand a person. Let trust guide your first move. The people who know you will learn to read the little signals without forcing them to become loud ones.","reason_codes":["repeated_opening","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Varies the repeated opening while preserving dignity for Kevin's small, trust-informed gestures."},{"field_path":"cards.9.card.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's favorite human must be ready to applaud, throw the toy, approve the route, and remain available for the return trip.","reason_codes":["administrative_humor_cluster","differentiate_voice"],"editorial_rationale":"Keeps the multiple-companion-roles humor without corporate title language."},{"field_path":"cards.9.card.no_astro.body.handler","action":"replace","replacement":"Kevin's relationship with a primary companion may organize far more than cuddling. It appears in the unusual entrance he wants noticed, the toy or game he initiates, the burst of action he wants witnessed, and the trust that lets him return to a shared cue. He may seem independent one minute and intensely companion-oriented the next. The pattern is not contradiction: his bond gives individuality an audience, energy a partner, and exploration a return address. Build it with attention, purposeful play, reliable practice, and room for Kevin's own moves.","reason_codes":["overexplained_body","remove_true_overexplanation"],"editorial_rationale":"Retains the card's structural insight while reducing the surrounding explanation."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.applicable_canine_jokes.0","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin does not make an entrance; he releases a limited-edition version of himself.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"This is concise, memorable, and perfectly fitted to the identity lens."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.donts.0","action":"keep","replacement":"Do not treat every unconventional response as defiance or every flourish as a demand for unlimited attention.","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Precisely balances Kevin's individuality with practical limits."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.donts.1","action":"keep","replacement":"Do not force instant sociability when a short inspection would help him orient.","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Offers identity-specific handling without duplicating the growth lens."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.donts.2","action":"keep","replacement":"Do not make closeness depend on Kevin abandoning his individuality.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"This is the summary's central relational thesis in a clear, humane line."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.dos.0","action":"keep","replacement":"Acknowledge Kevin's unusual first move, then give him one clear, low-drama way to rejoin the household plan.","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Strong, specific support for the identity lens."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.dos.1","action":"keep","replacement":"Use brief greeting rituals, choice-based cues, and shared play so independence has a cooperative outlet.","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Maintains the freedom-and-connection synthesis."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.dos.2","action":"keep","replacement":"Reward the return to connection—not only the spectacular entrance that preceded it.","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Memorable and behaviorally useful."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"keep","replacement":"Your exact Aquarius Ascendant opposite Leo Descendant says that meeting the world and meeting a companion are never entirely separate jobs. You may arrive through the side door of an idea, a surprise, or an independent inspection, yet your Leo relationship signature wants the close encounter to feel alive. Mars beside that Descendant gives your greetings paws and momentum. Pluto's supportive Libra links help you turn intensity into trust when the exchange is fair. Keep your originality; practice the return.","reason_codes":["keep_richness","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"A rich, evidence-faithful astrological rendering of the distinct identity thesis."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.body.handler","action":"keep","replacement":"The exact Aquarius Ascendant–Leo Descendant opposition places Kevin's visible approach and one-to-one bond across a strong freedom-and-connection axis. His Aquarius Ascendant can meet the world through pattern-breaking, independent responses; the Leo Descendant seeks a close counterpart who makes interaction lively and personal. Mars in Leo sits close to the Descendant, so action and display readily enter relationship. Pluto in Libra trines the Ascendant and sextiles the Descendant, adding a quietly intense capacity to deepen trust through fair, practiced exchange. In daily life, let the unusual first move exist, then channel the encounter into a clear reciprocal ritual.","reason_codes":["keep_richness","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Preserves a particularly successful, whole-chart identity synthesis."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.body.hybrid","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin's Aquarius Ascendant and Leo Descendant oppose at an exact degree, while Mars joins the Leo side: his independent first response and his expressive companion instinct can activate together. Pluto in Libra supports both ends by trine to the Ascendant and sextile to the Descendant, making trust a workable bridge rather than an abstract ideal. The human receives the surprising entrance, names the next cue, and joins the play. Kevin learns that a bond can contain a detour without losing its direction.","reason_codes":["keep_richness","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"The hybrid version has a distinct reciprocal action and retains the full claim."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.headline.direct_to_dog","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin, Be Original—and Come Back for the Applause","reason_codes":["keep_existing_peak","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Memorable identity headline."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.headline.handler","action":"keep","replacement":"Kevin's Chart Makes Room for a Dramatic Original","reason_codes":["keep_voice_or_rhythm","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Clear, warm, and distinct from the other summary lenses."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.full_astro.headline.hybrid","action":"keep","replacement":"The Dog Who Brings the Unexpected Move to a Two-Way Bond","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Captures the relationship interaction without flattening it."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.funny_dog_quotes.0","action":"keep","replacement":"“I have entered the room. Please adjust the room to acknowledge this development.”","reason_codes":["keep_voice_or_rhythm","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"The comic voice suits the identity introduction."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.imperative_dog_quotes.0","action":"keep","replacement":"Bring your strange idea, then bring it back to the team.","reason_codes":["keep_semantic_precision","summary_coherence"],"editorial_rationale":"Compactly states the summary's main developmental invitation."},{"field_path":"summary.card1.light_astro.body.direct_to_dog","action":"keep","replacement":"Your Aquarius rising side may take the unexpected path, but your Leo relationship side wants a real exchange at the end of it.
